semantics.out_assign: Continuous assign of a XOR b.
semantics.out_always_comb: Combinational always block assigns a XOR b with no storage.
semantics.out_always_ff: At every positive edge of clk, sample a XOR b and update the single flip-flop output via nonblocking assignment; hold between positive edges.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No specified initial registered value; leave uninitialized and do not require a binary value before first positive edge.
semantics.latency: Combinational outputs settle in the same simulation time; registered output reflects inputs sampled at the latest positive edge after nonblocking update.

numeric.arithmetic: No accumulation, overflow, rounding, saturation or truncation.
numeric.four_state: Standard SystemVerilog bitwise XOR semantics for X/Z operands.

verification.source: Independent testbench derived only from problem.txt.
verification.oracle: For binary inputs use inequality truth-table expectation rather than DUT expression.
coverage: All four binary combinations for both combinational outputs and rising-edge sampling.
Change inputs while clock is low and high to verify registered output holds.
Verify falling edges do not update the registered output.
Repeated sampling and all 16 transitions between binary input combinations.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs away from rising edges; check outputs after settling and NBA completion.
verification.initialization: Do not check initial registered output before first rising edge.
verification.tools: Explicit dev_tb top, Icarus -g2012, matching vvp, finite compile and simulation timeouts.
